{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out sentinel values (-1) in customer_age
valid_age_data = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age on valid data
mean_age = valid_age_data['customer_age'].mean()

print(f'Mean age (excluding -1 sentinels): {mean_age:.2f} years')"}
